title: Sharp Gaussian divergence and Bernstein-Markov inequalities
summary: We prove two dimension-free estimates in Gaussian space. The first is an optimal Meyer-type inequality for the Gaussian divergence: for $p\geq2$, \[ \|δV\|_{L^p(γ_d)} \leq \sqrt p\,|\mathbb E V| +Cp\,\|DV\|_{L^p(γ_d;\mathrm{HS}_d)}\, . \] Here $\mathrm{HS}_d$ is the space of $d\times d$ matrices with its Hilbert-Schmidt norm. Its main ingredient is a dimension-free weak-type $(1,1)$ bound for the second-order transform $D^2\mathcal N^{-1}$, where $\mathcal N := -Δ+x\cdot D$ is the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck operator.
